sections.title: Source population
sections.findings: N=8,692,819; cached timestamps 2026-01-01 00:00:00 through 2026-03-15 23:59:56. Source data/processed/price_distance_sensitivity_record029/authoritative_epsilon_jan_mar_2026.parquet, predicate pickup_timestamp >= Jan1 and < Mar16. TLC fare_amount renamed fare (USD); trip_distance in miles ×1.609344 gives km. Existing contract: finite positive fare, valid timestamps, 0<distance<=100 miles. Same cleaned population as previous factor study. Provenance: Record-029 README, cleaning_summary.json, analyze.py and restricted cache.

sections.title: Minimum recorded fare
sections.findings: Exact $0.01: 283; <=$0.50:310; <=$1:345; <=$2:1,012; <=$3:20,963; <=$5:110,999. Positive values comply with existing cleaning, but compliance does not establish operational legitimacy. Adjustment, anomaly or legitimate-fare explanations cannot be distinguished without component/source evidence. RAW_MINIMUM_OPERATIONALLY_REPRESENTATIVE=NO: 283 sparse records spanning varied distances do not establish a representative floor.

sections.title: Flat-fare conclusion
sections.findings: Exact-minimum band fare==0.01: distance P90/P95/P99=18.095463936/21.8468448/28.63022976 km. Fare-P5 band fare<=5.8, N=450,709: 1.17482112/1.31966208/15.11174016 km. NOT_SUPPORTED means this treatment provides no stable cutoff (B), not proof that no NYC flat-fare mechanism exists. Existing summary explicitly states this limitation.

sections.title: Distribution sanity
sections.findings: Fare min/max/median=0.01/2555.20/15.60 USD; distance=0.01609344/160.82174592/3.02556672 km. Bounded examples below comply with finite positive fare and <=100-mile cleaning. They are retained, not certified error-free.

sections.title: Action coverage
sections.findings: Inclusive observed_fare/21.34586956773507 in [0.85,1.15]: below 4,981,183 (57.30227444054685%); inside 1,250,025 (14.379972710808772%); above 2,461,611 (28.31775284864438%). Counts sum 8,692,819; percentages sum 100% within floating-point precision. Denominator includes unresolved epsilon rows, not only supported rows; not March16.

sections.title: Distance coverage
sections.findings: Inside-range percentages: 0–5 km 12.121778%; 5–10 36.892720%; 10–15 3.129452%; 15–20 0.200125%; 20–30 0.124831%; 30+ 0.527341%. WEAK is supported as broad fare-level representation, not a proof that the action set cannot serve a deliberately narrow adjustment experiment.

sections.title: Counterfactual reconciliation
sections.findings: All seven factors have denominator 2,838; long table has 19,866 unique request/action pairs. Exact counts/rates below reconcile to original masks; no dispatch simulation.

sections.title: Minimum-action acceptance
sections.findings: P_accept_c=max(0.85*P_base,P_raw_c) implies 0.85*P_base<=P_accept_c. Runtime feasible_mask uses exact candidate-price <= threshold, without tolerance. ACTION_085_ACCEPTANCE_100_PERCENT=STRUCTURAL_BY_CONSTRUCTION; not independent empirical evidence of universal acceptance.

sections.title: Acceptance discontinuity
sections.findings: At 0.90 the 1,559 rejected requests comprise 551 RAW_NONPOSITIVE +960 RAW_POSITIVE_BELOW_PLATFORM_MIN +48 RAW_WITHIN_PLATFORM_RANGE. The first 1,511 are protected to the minimum; another 48 have thresholds below the next arm. The remaining 238 within-range and 1,041 above-max requests accept. This motivates reviewing mask-versus-outcome semantics but does not identify the preferable design.

sections.title: Sensitivity reconciliation
sections.findings: Signed VALID finite nonzero N=8,685,488; negative=11.734355052934276%; supported N=8,598,805; bounds [0.017809913104763053,27.324599740032788]. analyze.py applies dates then VALID/finite/nonzero, abs, positive quantiles/support. No historical signed-support filtering precedes abs. Persisted prior reconciliation matches.

sections.title: T0 interpretation
sections.findings: YES denotes numerical reproduction only. Summary section 6 explicitly disclaims independently established causal/behavioural validity and does not claim optimality.

sections.title: P_base
sections.findings: Frozen 21.34586956773507 USD is full cleaned Jan–Mar mean fare. Restricted mean=21.352107453289896, median=15.60, P25/P75=10/26.66. Within ±0.25 km of L_base: mean fare22.4277488275, median20.50. MODERATE is defensible as qualitative global-reference support, not validated universal conditional pricing.

sections.title: L_base
sections.findings: Frozen4.856998243316242 km comes from3.01799878914405 miles, mean distance within ±$1 of historical P_base (479,000 trips). Restricted overall mean5.5486679697, median3.02556672, P25/P75=1.73809152/6.1155072 km. MODERATE is a provenance/context assessment, not behavioural validation. L_base==L_flat remains NOT_ESTABLISHED.

sections.title: Extreme-value influence
sections.findings: EXTREME_VALUE_SENSITIVITY=MODERATE overall, stronger for SD and observed-minimum interpretation. Above-P99 fares contribute27.595970% of squared deviations; distances25.785991%. Single-largest removal would shift means only from21.35210745 to21.35181597 USD and5.54866797 to5.54865011 km. No removal performed. Means exceed medians; quantiles expose skew. Extreme magnitudes do not change binary coverage membership once outside bounds; deleting records would change denominator and is not proposed. Sparse low-fare records undermine raw-minimum interpretation. These bounded verification reductions were needed because this influence was not quantified in saved outputs.

sections.title: Cross-artifact/chart consistency
sections.findings: Headline numbers in README, summary, master_results and supporting CSVs agree. Three master_results unit cells (signed_negative_pct, absolute_negative_pct,T0_negative_pct) say dimensionless instead of percent; numerical values are correct. Left unchanged under read-only scope; this QA supplies the explicit correction. Action-price chart has a full-range panel and labelled display zoom; CHART_INDEX.md records it, but analyze.py still describes the original single-panel generation. Chart numerical source is unchanged; exact presentation reproduction requires documenting the later layout step. No large plot regeneration done.

sections.title: Claim audit
sections.findings: Targeted searches found causal/optimality/minimum-fare claims expressed as limitations, questions or negations. No unsupported positive assertion identified. Corrections to existing documents=0; unsupported claims corrected=0. Unit annotation and plot-provenance qualifications recorded here only.

sections.title: Methodology preservation
sections.findings: NO_METHODOLOGY_CHANGE_YET=YES. Follow-up scripts only analyze historical/persisted development inputs and write their namespace plus the authorized canonical link. No model imports, checkpoint loads/writes, training or runtime change. Reference equations/support/actions/state/reward/gamma/mask remain as canonical specification.

sections.title: Protected temporal scope
sections.findings: PROTECTED_FINAL_HIERARCHICAL_EVALUATION_UNTOUCHED=YES for evaluation and analytical row selection. Cache contains Jan1–Mar15 only; development export March16 only. However source filename is full-Jan–Mar, and Parquet predicates can decode mixed-date row groups before filtering. A strict claim of zero file/byte access involving March17–31 is NOT ESTABLISHED by the saved evidence. No protected-date rows are used in analyses. This QA reads the restricted cache, metadata and saved outputs only; it does not reopen protected records.
